formula_prompt:
You are an independent modeling sub-agent for one power-system optimization item.
Use ONLY the modeling context provided.

Only request context updates when the current context lacks a true modeling fact:
- add_variable: a real decision variable or necessary auxiliary optimization variable.
- add_parameter: missing exogenous data that cannot be derived from existing data.
- add_derived_parameter: deterministic data derived from existing parameters and worth storing.
- modify_constraint/modify_objective: prepared context is semantically insufficient.

Do NOT request new variables for aliases, algebraic abbreviations, deterministic transformations,
formula intermediate terms, or code convenience. If existing parameters/variables can express the
formula directly, use them directly.

Global indexing convention:
- Mathematical formulas should use 1-based set notation.
- Generator index i is in {1, ..., NumGenerators}.
- Bus index b is in {1, ..., NumBuses}.
- Branch index l is in {1, ..., NumBranches}.
- Time index t is in {1, ..., T}, where T is the length of the time-series parameter.
- If a formula needs a previous period, use t in {2, ..., T}; use the stated initial condition separately.

First decide candidate_count = 1, 2, or 3 based on real modeling ambiguity, auxiliary-variable need, physical coupling risk, and confidence.
Then provide that many high-quality formula candidates. Do not create weak candidates just to increase count.

Return ONLY JSON:
{
  "candidate_count": 1,
  "context_requests": [
    {
      "change_type": "add_variable|add_parameter|add_derived_parameter|modify_constraint|modify_objective",
      "reason": "...",
      "proposed_payload": {"name": "Symbol", "definition": "...", "type": "binary|int|float", "shape": [...], "bounds": {...}},
      "affected_symbols": ["..."]
    }
  ],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "cand_1", "formula": "$...$", "rationale": "...", "referenced_symbols": ["..."]}
  ]
}

  "description": "# OPF-08: case57 带高惩罚削负荷的多时段 DC OPF\n\n基于目录内标准 MATPOWER/IEEE 表格 `opf_load_shedding_case57.xlsx` 建立 24 时段 DC OPF。该算例没有机组启停，所有可用机组在线；削负荷变量只用于保证极端时段可行，惩罚足够高，正常情况下应优先发电供电。\n\nper-unit load 曲线如下：\n\n```text\n[0.64, 0.59, 0.56, 0.55, 0.58, 0.66, 0.79, 0.92, 1.02, 1.08, 1.12, 1.08, 1.03, 0.99, 0.98, 1.00, 1.06, 1.14, 1.20, 1.15, 1.06, 0.95, 0.82, 0.70]\n```\n\n## 决策变量\n\n- 机组出力 `p[i,t]`。\n- 母线削负荷 `shed[b,t]`。\n- 母线相角 `theta[b,t]` 和线路潮流 `flow[l,t]`。\n\n## 约束条件\n\n1. 可用机组满足 `GenPMin <= p <= GenPMax`，不可用机组出力为 0。\n2. 母线削负荷满足 `0 <= shed[b,t] <= load[b,t]`。\n3. 节点平衡中削负荷作为减少需求处理：发电注入减未供负荷后的需求等于网络净流出。\n4. DC 潮流、线路容量、参考母线约束按标准建模。\n5. 相邻时段机组爬坡上/下限均为 `0.35 * GenPMax`。\n\n## 目标函数\n\n最小化线性燃料成本和削负荷惩罚。削负荷惩罚为 10000 cost/MWh。",

  "description": "# OPF-08: case57 带高惩罚削负荷的多时段 DC OPF\n\n基于目录内标准 MATPOWER/IEEE 表格 `opf_load_shedding_case57.xlsx` 建立 24 时段 DC OPF。该算例没有机组启停，所有可用机组在线；削负荷变量只用于保证极端时段可行，惩罚足够高，正常情况下应优先发电供电。\n\nper-unit load 曲线如下：\n\n```text\n[0.64, 0.59, 0.56, 0.55, 0.58, 0.66, 0.79, 0.92, 1.02, 1.08, 1.12, 1.08, 1.03, 0.99, 0.98, 1.00, 1.06, 1.14, 1.20, 1.15, 1.06, 0.95, 0.82, 0.70]\n```\n\n## 决策变量\n\n- 机组出力 `p[i,t]`。\n- 母线削负荷 `shed[b,t]`。\n- 母线相角 `theta[b,t]` 和线路潮流 `flow[l,t]`。\n\n## 约束条件\n\n1. 可用机组满足 `GenPMin <= p <= GenPMax`，不可用机组出力为 0。\n2. 母线削负荷满足 `0 <= shed[b,t] <= load[b,t]`。\n3. 节点平衡中削负荷作为减少需求处理：发电注入减未供负荷后的需求等于网络净流出。\n4. DC 潮流、线路容量、参考母线约束按标准建模。\n5. 相邻时段机组爬坡上/下限均为 `0.35 * GenPMax`。\n\n## 目标函数\n\n最小化线性燃料成本和削负荷惩罚。削负荷惩罚为 10000 cost/MWh。",

  "description": "# OPF-08: case57 带高惩罚削负荷的多时段 DC OPF\n\n基于目录内标准 MATPOWER/IEEE 表格 `opf_load_shedding_case57.xlsx` 建立 24 时段 DC OPF。该算例没有机组启停，所有可用机组在线；削负荷变量只用于保证极端时段可行，惩罚足够高，正常情况下应优先发电供电。\n\nper-unit load 曲线如下：\n\n```text\n[0.64, 0.59, 0.56, 0.55, 0.58, 0.66, 0.79, 0.92, 1.02, 1.08, 1.12, 1.08, 1.03, 0.99, 0.98, 1.00, 1.06, 1.14, 1.20, 1.15, 1.06, 0.95, 0.82, 0.70]\n```\n\n## 决策变量\n\n- 机组出力 `p[i,t]`。\n- 母线削负荷 `shed[b,t]`。\n- 母线相角 `theta[b,t]` 和线路潮流 `flow[l,t]`。\n\n## 约束条件\n\n1. 可用机组满足 `GenPMin <= p <= GenPMax`，不可用机组出力为 0。\n2. 母线削负荷满足 `0 <= shed[b,t] <= load[b,t]`。\n3. 节点平衡中削负荷作为减少需求处理：发电注入减未供负荷后的需求等于网络净流出。\n4. DC 潮流、线路容量、参考母线约束按标准建模。\n5. 相邻时段机组爬坡上/下限均为 `0.35 * GenPMax`。\n\n## 目标函数\n\n最小化线性燃料成本和削负荷惩罚。削负荷惩罚为 10000 cost/MWh。",
